name: Bromerguride
summary: Bromerguride (INNTooltip International Nonproprietary Name), also known as 2-bromolisuride, is an antidopaminergic and serotonergic agent of the ergoline group which was described as having atypical antipsychotic properties but was never marketed. It was the first antidopaminergic ergoline derivative to be discovered.

pharmacology.text: Bromerguride (INN), also known as 2-bromolisuride, is an antidopaminergic and serotonergic agent of the ergoline group which was described as having atypical antipsychotic properties but was never marketed. The pharmacodynamic actions of bromerguride are said to be "reversed" relative to its parent compound lisuride, a dopaminergic agent.

uses.text: Bromerguride (INN), also known as 2-bromolisuride, is an antidopaminergic and serotonergic agent of the ergoline group which was described as having atypical antipsychotic properties but was never marketed.

fact.en: It is lisuride with a bromine added, and both belong to the ergolines, the family that comes from the ergot fungus of rye. Unusually for an ergoline, it blocks dopamine rather than activating it.
fact.zh: 它是在 lisuride 上加一個溴的產物，兩者都屬於麥角林類，這個家族源自黑麥上的麥角真菌。與一般麥角林不同，它是阻斷多巴胺而非活化它。
